notes: Gen1Recomp now sets itself up. If you have a Gen 1 Pokemon Game Boy ROM on your console, the update fetches Gen1Recomp on its own shortly after the console starts, and your games appear as their own tiles on the Ports tab with nothing to press. It comes straight from bryanthaboi's own GitHub release and is checked against the checksum they publish with it, because they ask that builds only come from their github or their discord. It is about 33 MB and needs internet; if your console is offline it simply tries again next time you start it. Consoles with no Gen 1 ROM do not download anything. You can still install it by hand from the Ports tab of the console's web page on port 8097.
